definition: The work injury or exposure itself
example_phrase_from_notes: DOI December 9, Chloe was hit at an intersection driving the company vehicle

definition: Worker told the employer about the injury
example_phrase_from_notes: Reported to Ravi Brandt same day

definition: Employer reported the injury to the insurer (or sent Form C-2F)
example_phrase_from_notes: Employer reported it to SIF on December 14

definition: Adjuster's first summary when the claim is assigned
example_phrase_from_notes: First report: Chloe Nguyen / City Operations Dept, DOI December 9, SIF

definition: Search for earlier claims by the same worker
example_phrase_from_notes: prior claims search done, no hits

definition: Recorded statement from the injured worker
example_phrase_from_notes: Statement from Chloe Nguyen: Chloe states she was hit...

definition: Written statement from the employer supervisor
example_phrase_from_notes: Statement 12/15/2025 from Ravi Brandt at City Operations Department

definition: Decision to accept the claim or dispute it
example_phrase_from_notes: Disputing for now we need causation support C-7 sent to the Board

definition: Treating doctor's visit or office note
key_attributes: pain_score; assessment; work_status; restrictions; findings; next_appointment
example_phrase_from_notes: OFFICE NOTE 12/29/25 (Dr Haddad): SUBJECTIVE...

definition: Physical therapy session
example_phrase_from_notes: PT visit 2/6 January 16 (Riverbend PT). Tolerated tx well

definition: Imaging test authorized or ordered
example_phrase_from_notes: MRI auth'd, Northeast Diagnostic Imaging to schedule

definition: Result of an imaging test
example_phrase_from_notes: MRI ordered January 7, result January 18: mild disc bulge L4-5

definition: Nurse case manager contact or review
example_phrase_from_notes: Barrier to RTW: Transportation

definition: A future medical or therapy appointment named in a note
example_phrase_from_notes: next appt 12/14

definition: Worker did not attend an appointment
example_phrase_from_notes: says Chloe no showed the last appt

definition: Maximum medical improvement (MMI) or permanency rating discussed
example_phrase_from_notes: DR Haddad says MMI reached, rating pending

definition: Provider or attorney asks for approval of treatment or tests
example_phrase_from_notes: We are requesting 6 PT visits, please advise

definition: Adjuster approves or reviews a treatment request
example_phrase_from_notes: approved 6 PT visits at Riverbend Physical Therapy, auth # 44790

definition: Provider says it sent a bill
example_phrase_from_notes: Our billing for $152 was sent on December 12

definition: Bill review result
example_phrase_from_notes: PT visits ... $87.50 denied - no auth on file

definition: Prescription or pharmacy network check
example_phrase_from_notes: PPO pharmacy network rule explained to clmt

definition: Worker asks about or sends travel/mileage expenses (Form C-257)
example_phrase_from_notes: Asked about mileage reimbursement, told to send C-257 with receipts

definition: Employer gives the worker's pre-injury weekly wage
example_phrase_from_notes: Our payroll shows Chloe Nguyen earned about $690 a week

definition: Wage-loss payment or ledger entry
example_phrase_from_notes: Paid $657.00/wk thru 01JAN26

definition: Reserve set or reviewed by adjuster or supervisor
example_phrase_from_notes: med reserve $6,000. ok to keep the reserve as is

definition: A note states the total paid so far on the claim
example_phrase_from_notes: approx $520 paid to date

definition: Work status or restrictions reported
example_phrase_from_notes: Work status: Restr per Dr Haddad: No lifting over 10 lbs, no repeated bending

definition: Date the worker went back to full duty
example_phrase_from_notes: Back to full duty from February 18

definition: Employer offers light or modified duty
example_phrase_from_notes: We can offer light duty starting Nov 30, 4 hrs/day

definition: Employer reports missed days or lateness
example_phrase_from_notes: Employer says Chloe missed 9 days last month

definition: Independent medical examination set up
example_phrase_from_notes: IME sched February 20 with Dr Fischer. Purpose: Causation

definition: IME report received
example_phrase_from_notes: IME report in: Says tx is reasonable and ongoing

definition: Board hearing or conciliation conference set
example_phrase_from_notes: Next hearing is on November 10

definition: Board hearing or conciliation took place
example_phrase_from_notes: Hearing held February 20, adjourned for medical records

definition: Board decision or administrative determination notice received without a hearing
example_phrase_from_notes: "Admin determination notice rec'd 1/22/26"

definition: Attorney asks for records, payment, authorization or a hearing
example_phrase_from_notes: Please send the claim file, medical and wage records

definition: Settlement (Section 32) raised
example_phrase_from_notes: need Medicare status check before any Section 32

definition: Two-way contact with a party (phone call or email)
example_phrase_from_notes: Spoke with Chloe Nguyen . Address and phone confirmed

definition: Unsuccessful attempt to reach a party
example_phrase_from_notes: tried clmt again, VM full

definition: Message from the worker (portal, text, email, voicemail)
example_phrase_from_notes: portal msg (Chloe): nobody called me back abt MRI report

definition: Instruction from the claims supervisor
example_phrase_from_notes: need hearing prep done by 08/24/2026

definition: Formal status report sent to the client or carrier contact
example_phrase_from_notes: Subject: Status Report - Claim 6977160

definition: Adjuster diary check or file review: what the adjuster says the claim status is and what is next
example_phrase_from_notes: "File review January 9 ... claim is open, hearing coming up"

definition: A WCB form is received, sent, requested or pending
example_phrase_from_notes: MG-2 rec'd for low back, hip and both knees, reviewing

definition: Something the file is waiting for
example_phrase_from_notes: Still waiting on wage statement from the employer

definition: Claim or diary closed
example_phrase_from_notes: Closing note cx back to full duty since 12/9/25, no f/u needed

definition: Worker reports a flare-up after closure
example_phrase_from_notes: EE called, says ears flared up again
